path_decisions.rationale: RiskEngine filters signals AFTER consolidation — if consolidation cancels valid signals (unweighted vote at generator.py:63), risk engine never sees them. Fix consolidation first to feed better signals to risk
PositionSizer hardcodes win_rate=0.5 (position_sizer.py:39) — Kelly criterion with wrong win_rate causes systematic over/under-betting across all strategies
Mean reversion requires RSI+BB+volume all simultaneously (line 129-131) — same AND-logic problem as trend but with only 3 conditions. Relaxing to 2-of-3 increases signal frequency
RiskEngine VaR check (cvar_95 < -0.05 at risk_engine.py:131) is a blanket block — may prevent valid entries during high-vol regimes where mean-reversion opportunities are best

candidate_solution.summary: 4 changes: (1) risk-engine-aware signal priority, (2) actual win_rate Kelly sizing, (3) relax mean_rev AND-logic, (4) per-strategy risk budget

change_1.title: Add per-strategy risk budget instead of blanket portfolio-level checks
change_1.current: All strategies share the same daily_loss_limit, weekly_loss_limit, max_drawdown, and VaR checks. A single bad trade from one strategy can block all other strategies from entering.
change_1.proposed: Add strategy_risk_limits dict to RiskConfig: {strategy_id: {daily_loss_limit, max_position_pct}}. In check(), first check per-strategy limits (is this strategy already at its daily loss?), then fall back to portfolio-level checks. This prevents one strategy's drawdown from blocking entries from uncorrelated strategies.
change_1.rationale: Current architecture: if trend_following has a bad day hitting daily_loss_limit, mean_reversion and volatility_breakout are also blocked from entering — even though they're uncorrelated. Per-strategy risk budgets allow uncorrelated strategies to continue trading, maintaining overall win_rate when one strategy is in a drawdown.

change_2.title: Add strategy confidence ranking before consolidation
change_2.current: Simple net vote: LONG signals +1, SHORT -1. Conflicting signals cancel. No consideration of which strategy has better recent performance.
change_2.proposed: Before consolidation, rank strategies by recent hit_rate (from signal_quality.py metrics). When signals conflict, prefer the strategy with higher recent hit_rate. Implementation: add strategy_performance dict to SignalGenerator, use it as weight in consolidate_signals(). If trend_following has hit_rate=0.65 and mean_reversion has hit_rate=0.45, trend's vote gets 65% weight vs 45%.
change_2.rationale: When two strategies disagree on direction, the current system either cancels both (net=0→FLAT) or follows the majority. But strategies have different win rates — a HIGH win-rate strategy's signal should override a LOW win-rate strategy's signal. This directly increases win_rate by always following the better-performing strategy's conviction.

change_3.title: Relax mean_reversion AND-logic to min_conditions=2-of-3
change_3.current: entries = vol_ok & ((rsi < oversold & close < bb_lower) | (rsi > overbought & close > bb_upper)) — volume AND RSI AND BB all required
change_3.proposed: Add min_conditions param (default=3, set to 2 for optimization). Compute condition_count = vol_ok.astype(int) + rsi_extreme.astype(int) + bb_breach.astype(int). For long: entries = (condition_count >= min_conditions) & (direction == LONG). Same for short. This allows mean-reversion entries when 2 of 3 conditions hold, increasing signal frequency.
change_3.rationale: Mean reversion has only 3 conditions vs trend's 5, making the AND-logic even more restrictive proportionally. Allowing 2-of-3 (e.g., RSI oversold + close below BB lower without volume surge, or RSI oversold + volume surge without BB breach) captures setups that the current filter misses while maintaining directional conviction.

change_4.title: Add strategy-level correlation awareness to prevent correlated entries
change_4.current: PositionSizer treats each signal independently. If trend_following and volatility_breakout both signal LONG on the same symbol, they each get full Kelly sizing — total exposure exceeds risk limits.
change_4.proposed: Before sizing a new signal, check if other strategies already have positions in the same direction on the same symbol. If so, reduce the new signal's notional by (1 - existing_exposure_pct / max_position_pct). This prevents correlated strategy entries from exceeding portfolio-level position limits.
change_4.rationale: Correlated strategy entries on the same symbol can exceed max_position_pct even when each individual entry is within limits. This creates outsized losses when the position goes wrong, reducing win_rate through catastrophic single-trade outcomes. Cross-strategy position awareness prevents this.

notes: The risk engine architecture is fundamentally portfolio-level with no per-strategy granularity. This means a drawdown in one strategy blocks all others — a significant win-rate limiter for multi-strategy systems. The signal consolidation's unweighted vote is the second major issue: it discards high-conviction signals when low-conviction signals oppose them. Both changes improve win_rate by keeping good signals flowing and preventing bad ones from blocking.
